title: Suspend and resume of the NAS signalling connection

entities.name: Suspend and Resume of NAS Signalling Connection
entities.description: Procedure for suspending and resuming NAS signalling connection when user plane CIoT EPS optimization is used. Initiated by network for suspend and by UE for resume.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED
entities.description: EMM state where UE has an active NAS signalling connection with the network.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication
entities.description: EMM state where UE is idle but NAS signalling connection is suspended, not released.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE mode without suspend indication
entities.description: Normal EMM idle state without suspend indication.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Initial NAS message used for tracking area updating procedure.

entities.name: UE radio capability information update needed IE
entities.description: Information element indicating UE radio capability information needs update.

entities.name: RRC connection suspended
entities.description: Condition when lower layers indicate RRC connection has been suspended.

entities.name: RRC connection resumed
entities.description: Condition when lower layers indicate RRC connection has been resumed.

entities.name: Secure exchange of NAS messages not terminated
entities.description: Property indicating secure NAS message exchange continues despite suspension.

entities.name: Cipher NAS message
entities.description: Action to cipher NAS message as specified in clause 4.4.5 before sending.

relations.description: Suspend procedure requires UE to be in EMM-CONNECTED mode.
RRC connection suspended indication causes UE to enter EMM-IDLE mode with suspend indication.
RRC suspension does not terminate secure NAS message exchange.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message may contain UE radio capability information update needed IE.
Presence of UE radio capability update needed IE causes transition to EMM-IDLE without suspend indication.
RRC connection resumed indication causes UE to enter EMM-CONNECTED mode.
RRC resume triggers ciphering of pending initial NAS message before sending.
